properties.description: Core: the layout of a design reassembles to the same nodes, edges and whole-design hash; an unchanged design rewrites nothing; one change writes one file; a changed item names its anchor hash across repeated exports and gets the anchor's file back when changed back; a new item has no prev; outside git it chains from disk; a tampered or misplaced item is named and two files for one item are refused; an unknown field is refused; ids become safe file names. MCP: export_graph to a directory writes the layout, design.json holds graph_id and schema_version only, the layout ignores its taken_at sidecar, an unchanged re-export writes nothing, import_graph reads it back to the same hash, a changed item chains from main in a real git repo while untouched items keep main's bytes, a directory holding other files is refused, and a tampered item is named on import.
properties.findings: 2026-10-03 (chg:the-design-is-saved-one-file-per-item-2026-10-03): 12 of 12 core tests (the 8 layout tests) and 3 of 3 MCP tests pass.
properties.name: An item-layout write reads back as the same design and anchors each changed item at the merge-base
